subject: Devkit bridge: SDK auth, routing & local runbook (post-demo)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Reynolds <sam.reynolds@aretehealth.com>, Alice Chen <alice@brightpath.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Devkit bridge: SDK auth, routing & local runbook (post-demo)

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — good conversation. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we’re aligned for the pilot: 

Summary of what we covered
- SDKs: Python + TypeScript official devkits; sampleapps for search, chat, and tool-calling.
- Auth: you indicated pilot preference for API keys, but you may require short-lived credentials for production (we support both API keys and short-lived OAuth/KMS-backed tokens).
- Routing: desired policy = latency-first for patient-facing queries; cost-fallback to smaller quantized model for background batch jobs.
- Structured output/tool calling: plan to use the tool-calling primitives for EHR lookups + structured JSON output for downstream processing.
- Embeddings / reranker: plan to use semantic vector search (512-d) + a reranker model for top-10 precision.

Action items (owners & timing)
1) Redwood: share a minimal local quickstart repo (Python + TS), plus a short runbook for auth and routing. I attached the checklist and included a tiny example .env and Dockerfile stub for local testing. (Attachment: redwood-devkit-quickstart-checklist.pdf) — Vanessa by EOD 5/28.
2) Arete: confirm pilot environment details (AWS account, region, any proxy/VPC constraints), and whether PHI will be present during the pilot. Sam — please reply inline.
3) Tech call: schedule a 60-min deep-dive next week with Karthik (runtime + routing) and Marissa (SDK/sample apps). Proposed slots: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT.

Quick implementation notes for your engineers
- Local testing: sampleapps run with a single command (docker-compose/pnpm + small .env).
- Auth: API_KEY works for beta; for production we recommend short-lived tokens + KMS if you need key rotation auditing.
- Routing: we’ll provide a policy template (latency/cost/region priority) you can import via the Console or API.

Please confirm the AWS account region and whether PHI will be part of pilot traffic (this affects Dedicated/private options). I’ll follow up with the GitHub link and the checklist momentarily.

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0187

- AWS account: arete-pilot (account id 842711234567), region us-east-1.
- Pilot data: early pilot will use de-identified clinical notes (no PHI), but production is likely to include PHI — we’ll need the Private/VPC option and KMS in that phase.

Answers and confirmations: 
- Noted: account arete-pilot / us-east-1 and pilot uses de-identified notes. For production with PHI we’ll recommend Private + KMS; I’ll flag that in the proposal.
- Embedding dims: 512 is a reasonable starting point and will keep cost down; we can run an A/B with 768 for a small sample set and share recall/latency trade-offs. Karthik, can your team produce a short eval script we can run against Arete’s sample to compare 512 vs 768?
- Tech call: Tue 6/1 10:00 PT works for me. I’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda and include the GitHub quickstart.

Forwarding Sam’s confirmation — internal notes and asks below.

Context: Arete will pilot in us-east-1 using de-identified notes (no PHI for pilot). Production will likely need Private/VPC + KMS. They prefer API keys for pilot speed.

Internal asks: 
- Karthik: please prepare a short eval script (Python) that runs embeddings at 512 and 768 on a small sample and outputs recall + avg latency. Keep it runnable from the quickstart repo with an env var to switch dims. Target: < 48 hours to handoff.
- Marissa: add a README snippet to the sampleapps explaining the routing policy import and show 2 example policy JSONs (latency-first & cost-fallback). Include a quick dev note on when to use function/tool calling vs structured JSON prompts.
- Ops/Enterprise note: we may need to pre-qualify Dedicated capacity for production due to PHI. Flag this for the AE.

No need to respond-all — please share PRs against the devkit-quickstart repo and I’ll push the calendar invite for 6/1 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Vanessa
